req.title: Basic-auth rejects wrong password
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 401 and WWW-Authenticate: Basic when Basic-auth credentials are missing or wrong.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> must return HTTP 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Basic when credentials are missing or wrong, and HTTP 200 with authenticated payload when correct. Tests cover: (1) positive EP – correct credentials yield 200 + JSON payload; (2) negative EP – wrong password yields exactly 401 + WWW-Authenticate header; (3) negative EP – missing Authorization header yields 401; (4) DT – correct user but wrong password (one field wrong); (5) BVA – empty string password in path vs supplied credential; (6) NEG – no Authorization header at all, asserting exact header value. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (401 not >=400), exact header string content, exact JSON field values, and both sides of the boolean check in check_basic_auth (auth and auth.username==user and auth.password==passwd).

tests.name: test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_returns_200
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/testuser/testpass with correct Basic auth header
expected: JSON body contains authenticated=true and user='testuser'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-019: expected outcome HTTP 2xx with expected payload
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

def test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_returns_200():
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'testuser:testpass').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/testuser/testpass',
        headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['authenticated'] == True
    assert data['user'] == 'testuser'

test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_returns_200()

preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/testuser/testpass with wrong password in Basic auth header
expected: WWW-Authenticate header present and starts with 'Basic'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-019: error pathway HTTP 401; WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm header
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

def test_basic_auth_wrong_password_returns_401():
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'testuser:WRONGPASS').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/testuser/testpass',
        headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 401
    www_auth = r.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate', '')
    assert www_auth.startswith('Basic')
    assert 'realm' in www_auth.lower()

test_basic_auth_wrong_password_returns_401()

tests.name: test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_json_fields_exact

Endpoint returns JSON with authenticated and user fields on success
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/alice/secret with correct Basic auth
trace: R-HTTPBIN-019: expected outcome HTTP 2xx with expected payload; core.py basic_auth returns jsonify(authenticated=True, user=user)
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

def test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_json_fields_exact():
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'alice:secret').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/alice/secret',
        headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert set(data.keys()) == {'authenticated', 'user'}
    assert data['authenticated'] is True
    assert data['user'] == 'alice'

test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_json_fields_exact()

tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

def test_basic_auth_both_wrong_returns_401_not_200():
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'baduser:badpass').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/user/pass',
        headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 401
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 403
    www_auth = r.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate', '')
    assert 'Basic' in www_auth

test_basic_auth_both_wrong_returns_401_not_200()
